summary: No actionable defects found in the independent static numerical review. Required execution evidence remains unverified: the read-only sandbox and review instructions prohibit running checks. No files were changed.

checks.criterion: AC1: Tests precede implementation and a failing run is recorded.
checks.evidence: The 72b3fe4 tree imports HurstFit in test_terrain_fingerprint.py while terrain.py lacks that symbol, establishing test-first ordering. Notes exist at scripts/ralph/batches/t3-terrain/prd.json:275, but the historical failing execution was not independently observed; execution is prohibited.

checks.criterion: AC2: Configured lags satisfy three-cell, quarter-window and valid-pair support rules.
checks.evidence: Static inspection agrees with the contract: terrain.py:744 reads configured lags; terrain.py:896 applies >=3 cells and <=W/4; terrain.py:904 checks directional support and pairs. Tests at test_terrain_fingerprint.py:168 cover all five default lags and subsequent tests cover boundaries and local exclusions. Runtime confirmation is prohibited in the read-only sandbox.

checks.criterion: AC3: H uses configured lag-count and span gates, including exactly 4x.
checks.evidence: terrain.py:732 reads both thresholds; terrain.py:684 rejects insufficient count and span with separate reasons. test_terrain_fingerprint.py:353 covers three lags, spans below 4x and exactly 4x; :376 varies configuration thresholds. These tests were not executed because execution is prohibited.

checks.criterion: AC4: Zero nu prevents H without epsilon or log(0); relief and texture remain separate.
checks.evidence: terrain.py:688 checks zero before logarithms; :771 creates separate variants. Tests at test_terrain_fingerprint.py:449 spy on logarithms, :528 check constants, :537 check plane relief H=1 and texture nu_zero, and :665 check a zero at only some lags. Runtime verification is prohibited.

checks.criterion: AC5: Valid-fraction exclusion, equality boundary, all-nodata and undersized windows.
checks.evidence: terrain.py:752 retains counts and fraction and accepts fraction>=min_fraction. Tests at test_terrain_fingerprint.py:710 and :722 assert 2420/3025 passes and 2419/3025 fails; :765 covers all-nodata and :223 covers no supported lag in a small window. Execution is prohibited in the read-only sandbox.

checks.criterion: AC6: Documented H estimator and exact-power-law recovery at the prescribed tolerance.
checks.evidence: terrain.py:690 implements the centered OLS slope of ln(nu) on ln(L), which algebraically equals H for nu=c*L^H. Its docstring at :96 and story notes at scripts/ralph/batches/t3-terrain/prd.json:275 document the estimator decision. Tests at test_terrain_fingerprint.py:391 cover H=0.3,0.5,0.8 using rtol=1e-10 and atol=1e-12; :409 independently compares with polyfit. Numerical execution is prohibited.

checks.criterion: AC7: Configured detrending, nodata-safe plane fit, tilt metadata and nullable output.
checks.evidence: terrain.py:824 validates policies; :1000 selects only valid cells for exact normal equations; :1042 converts fitted slopes and intercept to the D29 metre frame. Output alignment at :949 preserves None. Tests at test_terrain_fingerprint.py:562, :611, :801 and :838 exercise nodata, independent plane residuals, policies and metadata. Runtime confirmation is prohibited.

checks.criterion: AC8: Record the supplied coarsening factor without inferring source support.
checks.evidence: terrain.py:736 validates the supplied factor, :739 checks its relationship to grid spacing, and :803 records it. The implementation contains no source-resolution inference or resampling path. Tests at test_terrain_fingerprint.py:260 and :280 cover supplied factors.

checks.criterion: Independent numerical derivation and static validity review.
checks.evidence: Compared PRD.md:351 and :450 with terrain.py:438, :690 and :986. Pair offsets correctly map north to decreasing rows. The plane normal equations, determinant signs, residual subtraction and conversion from doubled cell coordinates to east/north metre slopes are consistent. H is the log-log slope, without an erroneous factor of two. Missing measurements remain None.

Per-commit path inspection of 72b3fe4, 2afd4a8, 873247d and 2461e06 shows only the two specified review files changed. config/run.yaml:1 preserves unresolved kickoff values as null; :23 retains the prescribed terrain settings. Synthetic surfaces occur in the test file, with no production mock-data path introduced.
